title: Locally bounded masses of blow-ups at moving centres, from the monotonicity inequality
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) an integer multiplicity current (IsIntegerMultiplicity T). Assume: for every compact K ⊆ U there is Λ ≥ 0 such that for all y ∈ ℝ^P and R ∈ ℝ with closedBall(y, R) ⊆ K the function ρ ↦ ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρⁿ)·M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) (values in [0, ∞]) is monotone on (0, R). Let x ∈ U, x_j ∈ ℝ^P with x_j → x, and λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0. Then for every R ∈ ℝ there is c ∈ [0, ∞) (c ≠ ∞) such that M_{B_R(0)}(blowUp T x_j λ_j) ≤ c for all large j (eventually in atTop), where B_R(0) = ball 0 R and blowUp T x_j λ_j = η_{x_j,λ_j#}T ∈ 𝒟_n(η_{x_j,λ_j}(U)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ K → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → ∀ (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, c ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (blowUp T (xs j) (lams j) (hlams j).ne').massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c
